```{r setup}
#| include: false
lib <- Sys.glob("../renv/library/*/R-4.6/*")
.libPaths(c(lib, .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(knitr) })

data_dir <- Sys.getenv("TESI_DATA")
stopifnot("TESI_DATA not set" = nzchar(data_dir), dir.exists(data_dir))
aim1_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "derived", "aim1")
tissues <- c("colon", "lymphoid", "brain")

# read <tissue>_<mode>_aim1_<what>.csv written by scripts/07_aim1.R; NULL (with a note) if missing
rd_aim1 <- function(tissue, what, mode = "main") {
  f <- file.path(aim1_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_aim1_%s.csv", tissue, mode, what))
  if (!file.exists(f)) { message("missing: ", f); return(NULL) }
  read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
show_aim1 <- function(what, mode = "main", n = 30) {
  for (t in tissues) {
    x <- rd_aim1(t, what, mode)
    cat("\n\n**", t, "**\n\n", sep = "")
    if (is.null(x)) cat("*not available yet*\n") else print(kable(head(x, n)))
  }
}
```

**Single goal.** Measure how close the cell-type mean profiles μ of each source are to real held-out profiles of the same tissue and cell type (Aim 1; PROTOCOLLO §1, §5.5; ADEMP §5.1).

**Dependencies.** T2 (ADEMP v1.5 approved on 2026-11-18, DECISIONS 2026-11-18); main references of the three tissues (`scripts/03_reference.R <tissue> main`). **Branch.** `thesis/expression-sources`. **Data.** `TESI_DATA` on lesexp. **Script.** `scripts/07_aim1.R` (`plan`, then `main`).

# 1. Pre-registration

Written on 2026-11-18, before the Aim 1 plan and run. Rules from `protocol/ADEMP.md` v1.5 (approved 2026-11-18).

## 1.1 Design

| Item | Rule fixed before the run | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Targets | each of the 4 donors of the held-out group per tissue | DECISIONS 2026-10-30; ADEMP §2.5 |
| Cell types evaluated | types with ≥ 50 cells in the target donor and in training; others "not evaluated", without penalty | DECISIONS 2026-10-29 |
| Arms | E, C−, P (distribution properties only), E′ on all 6 pairs of the group; G only after its DECISIONS row; O is not an Aim 1 arm | ADEMP §2.1, §5.1; DECISIONS 2026-11-04 |
| Correlation | Pearson on log(1 + 10⁴ μ) over the §2.6 gene list (main), Spearman as sensitivity | DECISIONS 2026-10-30; ADEMP §5.1 |
| Noise ceiling | split halves within type, Spearman–Brown, √reliability; B = max(10, ⌈(SD_upper / 0.005)²⌉) per tissue | DECISIONS 2026-10-26, 2026-11-11; ADEMP §5.1 |
| Top-k markers | Jaccard of the top-100 by log2 fold-change; curve for k = 10, 20, 50, 100, 200 | ADEMP §5.1 |
| Separability | silhouette per type, 2,000 VST genes, 50 PCs, cells from the common noise model, as many per type as the target | ADEMP §5.1; DECISIONS 2026-11-04 |
| Arm P | silhouette; quantiles (10, 50, 90, 99, 99.9 %) and KS distance of gene means and of top-100 marker fold-changes, against the target and against E | DECISIONS 2026-11-04 (two rows) |
| Draws of C− and P | n = max(10, ⌈(SD_upper / 0.005)²⌉), largest over donors, types and measures, per tissue; pilot draws kept | DECISIONS 2026-11-11 |
| Seed | 42 | ADEMP §8 |

## 1.2 Expectations

| Expectation | Read on | Source |
|---|---|---|
| H1: among the arms with real genes, C− has the lowest fidelity in every tissue | Pearson, Jaccard top-100, silhouette | ADEMP §1, H1 |
| H2: E′ gives the donor-to-donor scale; a source close to E′ is "as good as another real donor"; exceeding E′ is not leakage | all fidelity measures, on the 6 pairs | ADEMP §1, H2; §9 point 2 |
| No source exceeds the noise ceiling beyond Monte Carlo error; if one does, it is investigated before going on | Pearson against √reliability | ADEMP §9 point 2 |
| P: gene-by-gene correlation and marker overlap about zero by construction, not a finding; P read only on distributions | P distribution measures | ADEMP §5.1; DECISIONS 2026-11-04 |
| P separability weak by design (random markers) | silhouette of P | tracker, T3 |

Discrepancies from these expectations are reported as results, not corrected (PROTOCOLLO §3.1).
